title: Industrial Relation
sources_used: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Identify the type(s) of trade unions formed in Sunrise Engineering Ltd.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: Types of Trade Unions
  • ▪ Politically Affiliated Trade Union – Linked with a national political party
  • ▪ Independent Trade Union – Not affiliated with any political party
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: ▪ Independent Trade Union – Not affiliated with any political party

questions.question: Apply the functions of trade unions to explain how the unions could have effectively represented workers.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyze the problems of trade unions evident in this case.
  • Ans: Problems of Trade Unions in the Case
  • ▪ Multiplicity of unions leading to division
  • ▪ Inter-union rivalry weakening bargaining power
  • ▪ Political interference affecting decisions
  • ▪ Poor leadership and lack of unity
  • ▪ Ineffective communication with management
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
